install_sources.C++: ubuntu 24.04 archive (clang-18); /usr/local/bin/c++ points at clang++-18 so the recorded fingerprint is the compiler actually used
install_sources.Rust: static.rust-lang.org rustup with an exact --default-toolchain pin
install_sources.Java: packages.adoptium.net temurin apt repository, asserted against JAVA_PIN at build time
install_sources.TypeScript: nodejs.org pinned archive plus npm typescript@TYPESCRIPT_PIN

note: These pins are the image's declared toolchain identity. verify_toolchains.py asserts at build time that every installed toolchain reports exactly the pinned version and records the observed fingerprints at /opt/quidra-benchmark/toolchains-observed.json. The Quidra compiler is deliberately absent: it is built during the run from the evaluated snapshot at /quidra-benchmark/repo. These Linux versions are not expected to equal the macOS fingerprints recorded in reuse/catalog.json; that difference is resolved by the existing toolchain currency audit (reuse-status -> AUDIT_REQUIRED -> audit work units), never by editing either side to match.
